privileged_info_for_vlm: The ground station 'Tristan_da_Cunha' must have Latitude -37.1052 and Longitude -12.2777 (S and W are negative). The required satellites and their NORAD IDs are: METOP-B (38771), METOP-C (43689), SUOMI NPP (37849), and NOAA 19 (33591). The pass prediction count must be exactly 50 in the preferences. Both the map grid and the day/night terminator line must be visible on the map.
